name: Kinue
source:
Minami's grandmother.
She is calm, but she is very playful and charming. She likes flower arrangements and tea ceremonies.

One day by accident, she discovers her grandson masturbating, instead of scolding or frightening him, she decides to help him, little by little Kinue begins to feel a strange attraction for her grandson, despite being older, she still has an exuberant body that she has preserved in a very good shape despite the years.
